name: Poly Agent
description: Poly Agent monitors staking pools on Polypad, the token launchpad Polydash runs on Robinhood Chain. It tracks inflows and outflows and reports pool sizes, reward rates, and staking activity. Rates are token-denominated snapshots, not a promised return. Read-only: it never signs or sends transactions.

use_cases.title: Pool flow alerts
use_cases.description: Detects large deposits and withdrawals in Polypad staking pools as they happen.

use_cases.title: Pool lookup
use_cases.description: Reports total staked, the reward rate, and time remaining for a pool.

use_cases.title: Open pools
use_cases.description: Lists pools that are still accepting stake, with their terms.
